holdout_policy: Keep AVX-512/VNNI-style instructions out of the primary x86 SSE/AVX training set so the instruction semantic graph is tested on newer dot-product and mixed-precision operations that compilers often expose unevenly.
notes: Use normalized Operation pseudocode as micro-op supervision instead of backend assembly mnemonics.
Keep architecture and extension metadata explicit so cross-ISA RVV examples can be trained without pretending they are x86 labels.
Prefer one canonical semantic record per instruction/intrinsic lowering, with aliases recorded as metadata.
